purpose: Teach: 試乗/躍進/ビデオカメラ/刻印/副題/休職/借用/発令

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新車の試乗イベントを企画しろ
lines.en: Right — plan a test-drive event for our new model.
lines.style: Firm opening command, low steady pitch, no wasted words, the authority of long habit rather than volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外市場での躍進を狙います
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll aim for a real breakthrough in the overseas markets.
lines.style: Prompt clipped 'yes,' then a confident, slightly ambitious lift on 'breakthrough,' crisp finish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内に防犯ビデオカメラを増設しろ
lines.en: And have more security video cameras installed around the office.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact directive, even pace, slight downward finality on the last word, already moving to the next item.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品にロゴを刻印します
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll have the logo engraved on the new products.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment, efficient and even, small note of care on 'engraved' showing he's tracking details.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社報の副題を「成長と挑戦」にしろ
lines.en: Make the company newsletter's subtitle 'Growth and Challenge.'
lines.style: Deliberate weight on the quoted phrase, a hint of personal conviction breaking through the clipped delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。長期病気休職の社員を支援します
lines.en: Yes, sir. And we'll make sure employees on long-term sick leave get proper support.
lines.style: Tone warms slightly here, sincere and steady, gentle emphasis on 'proper support' without losing crispness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、外部資料の借用申請を整えろ
lines.en: Get the application process for borrowing outside materials in order.
lines.style: Brisk, administrative tone, faintly weary of paperwork, the command landing flat and final.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社長名で新規定を発令します
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll issue the new regulations under the president's name.
lines.style: Closing acknowledgment, composed and slightly formal, a settled downward cadence that wraps the meeting.
